description: Behavioral Anomaly Detection — Data Taxonomy & Assumptions Document

schema.timestamp: ISO-8601 datetime of the access event
schema.source_ip: IPv4 address of the originating client
schema.geo_location: City, Country-code of the source IP
schema.resource_accessed: API endpoint or file path accessed
schema.auth_method: Authentication type: password | mfa | sso | api_key | certificate
schema.command_sequence: JSON array of commands executed during session
schema.device_fingerprint: OS/MAC address string identifying the device
schema.label: Ground-truth class: 'normal' or attack taxonomy label

brute_force.description: Rapid repeated authentication attempts (8-20 within seconds)

impossible_travel.description: Logins from geographically distant locations within impossibly short timeframes

credential_stuffing.description: Multiple different accounts accessed from a single IP in rapid succession

lateral_movement.description: Sequential access to multiple sensitive resources atypical for the entity

device_spoofing.description: Access from a device fingerprint inconsistent with the entity's established baseline

low_and_slow_exfil.description: Small, periodic data exports during off-hours over multiple days

insider_drift.description: Gradual escalation to sensitive resources outside the entity's normal access pattern
indicators: Access to HR / admin / secrets endpoints

behavioral_assumptions.users: Work during defined hours (07-20 h), access 3-6 habitual resources, operate from 1-2 geo locations
behavioral_assumptions.service_accounts: Operate 24/7 from fixed data-center locations, authenticate via api_key or certificate
behavioral_assumptions.edge_devices: Operate 24/7 from a single location, access a limited resource set, use certificate auth
behavioral_assumptions.cold_start: Brand-new entity IDs with 1-3 days of history; no established behavioral baseline for comparison
